captions: Muir Inlet, Glacier Bay, Alaska. Real elevation data, true scale.
In 1941 ice filled this inlet. Muir Glacier was a tidewater glacier that calved into the sea.
Ahead: the area of Muir Glacier today.
shots.audioDescription: The camera flies low up a long fjord between snow-capped ridges, heading north-west toward the head of the inlet.
